To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
SOD1(hWt) does not facilitate but impedes the aggregation of SOD1 mutants.
SOD1(hwt) does not facilitate but impedes the aggregation of mutant SOD(het) and that SOD1(mwt) does not contribute to the formation of mutant SOD aggregates.
SOD1(hwt) does not facilitate but impedes the aggregation of mutant SOD(G37R), G85R or G93C.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new aspect of SOD1 biology, namely that SOD1(hwt) does not facilitate but impedes mutant SOD1 aggregate formation.
the question whether wild-type SOD(hWT), which is not involved in the disease process, is able to facilitate mutant SOD1 aggregates.
an alternative mechanism of SOD1(WWT)-dependent toxicity in ALS.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
SOD1(hwt) does not facilitate mutant SOD1 aggregate formation but rather hinders it, at least under the in vitro conditions used here.
SOD1(hwt) does not facilitate mutant SOD1 protein aggregation but impedes it.
SOD(hWT), which is a highly abundant protein, does not contribute to mutant SOD1 aggregates but rather prevents mutant SOD1 from aggregation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
SOD1(hwt) does not facilitate but impedes the aggregation process.
the expression of mutant SOD forms leads to the formation of toxic oligomers, while wild-type SOD forms are able to keep the mutant SOD1 proteins in a soluble state.
SOD1(hwt) impedes the formation and accumulation of mutant SOD aggregates, which is the reason for the observed exacerbation of the phenotype in vivo.
The main takeaway from our work is that
wild-type SOD does not facilitate the formation of mutant SOD aggregates, but rather impedes it.
the presence of wild type SOD1 does not facilitate, rather impedes the formation and/or maintenance of aggregates of amyotrofic lateral sclerosis causing mutant superoxide dismutases.
SOD1(hW) does not facilitate the formation of aggregates but rather impedes them.
